snippet.title: Alien Apocalypse - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635510/Alien_Apocalypse/

Alien Apocalypse is an open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.
